description: The region-aware loader's mechanism and the committed North American map: tools/discs/elf_region_map.py makes the identity map from the PAL executable against itself and recovers a synthetic relocation (+0x10000: every section and the segment moved, every pointer word and the code's lui of the program's addresses rebased) from the PAL executable against the moved copy; the map applied -- by the tool and by the game's own loader -- rebuilds the PAL data image byte for byte; the game RUNS from the moved executable through its map (the hub leg's pictures, sound and states equal the PAL executable's); the mod tool's C++ map maker writes the same files; and with the retail North American disc both tools make launcher/discs/region_map_SLUS-20909.json byte for byte. The executables are read from the discs into a temporary folder and deleted at the end (no game data in the tree).
